notes.title: March 7th Update
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/wcsu30j.png]
OMG health bars! We've got health bars! Please please, put down that Game Of The Year Award, it's only March. But thank you, I feel honoured.

This update also adds a few other things:
* Better ship balancing
* Varied inventory sizes for each ship!
* Player mining ships are now legally allowed to mine Reddium. Cops will only attack you if you carry Reddium in a non-mining ship now.

Enjoy! More to come!

notes.title: February Update - Become Vermin!
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/GCi79to.png]

I promised some folks a February update, and thanks to Leap Day I juuuust made it! This update adds a new playable ship: the missile-flinging Vermin machine. To unlock this ship, destroy a single Vermin ship (or have the TriceraCops or Raptors do it for you).

In case you don't know how to unlock the other ships, here's a recap: the TriceraCop cruiser is unlocked by selling 6 teeth in a single game, and the Stego mining vessel is unlocked by selling yellow ore. To choose your ship, simply right-click (or press Y on your gamepad) in the player select screen.

There are a few other minor tweaks too, cleaning up some menus and some shader work. More updates to come soon, so enjoy!

notes.title: November Update: Playable Police Ship & Trading Cards
notes.content:
With this update you'll be able to pilot a TriceraCop cruiser! It's more heavily armoured than the starting player ship, but has a much shorter flight range, so you'll have to stick close to the centre of the map. ːtriceracopː

This isn't shown in-game yet, but the Miner and TriceraCop ships are now locked by default. To unlock the Miner ship you need to sell your first piece of gold mineral. To unlock the Cop ship, you need to sell your first pirate tooth. In the ship select screen, press Right Mouse Button (PC) or the Y Button (Xbox Gamepad) to toggle between your unlocked ships.

We've also added trading cards! Huzzah! They like jpegs, but you can trade them or turn them into other kinds of jpegs! ːverminː

Enjoy, and thank you for playing! More updates to come :) Next on our to-do is playable Pirate ships, a new enemy type and new Risks.

notes.title: Bug Fixes & New Playable Ship
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/wOTr9sx.png]

Greetings everyone! Development on the game continues and today's patch fixes several small bugs and introduces one new feature.

[b]Minor Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Minerals will no longer lose their colour and appear white
[*]Comets will no longer destroy buildings
[*]Added a bit of polish and animation to the player select screen
[/list]

[b]New Feature - Mining Ship[/b]

This feature is still a work in progress, but I thought I'd make this ship playable ASAP to get your input. When this feature is done these ships will be unlocked by performing certain feats in-game, but for now the Mining Ship is unlocked from the start.

To switch to the Mining Ship, press the Right Mouse Button (or Y Button if you're playing on Gamepad) when you see your ship in the Player Select screen. The mining ship is bigger and slower, but has much more health than the regular ship. Its weapon, the grinder, uses no ammo so weapon upgrades serve no purpose.

This will require a lot more balancing and polish later, including changes to the HUD. But for now, enjoy and drop a note in the Community Hub if you want to share your thoughts.

Coming soon: playable Triceracops ship...

Thanks, and have fun!

-Simon P

notes.title: Patch - New Art, Rebalancing & Full Controller Support
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/3iVT45v.png[/img]
Today's update includes a mix of gameplay balance changes and art improvements. 
[list]
    [*]New skybox
    [*]New models for mineral pickups
    [*]Full controller support is added
    [*]The "Contraband" Risk now also gives you free fuel when you sell Blutonium 
[/list]
If you've got any feedback on these changes, let us know in the Community Hub. You can also just play the old version, too! Right-click on the game in your Steam library and click "Properties". In the "beta" tab select "previous" and your game will un-update to yesterday's version of the game.

Thank you all for your support! Stay tuned, we'll have news on the next BIG update soon...

notes.title: August 3rd Patch - New Stuff In-Game!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Last night we uploaded a patch to [b]Cashtronauts[/b] that adds a lot of new stuff. If you unlocked all of 6 of the old Risks, now's a good time to dive in and see what new content has appeared!
[list]
    [*]The "cash cap" has increased from $40M to $250M
    [*]4 new Risks added, and many of the old ones have been redone
    [*]Plenty of rebalancing including tweaking of enemy HP, loot drops and more
    [*]Directional arrow doesn't appear until you're further away from the center
[/list]
This is the last big content change before the Early Access release, from here on out it's just balance fixes, polish and fixing stuff like cloud saves. If there's time we'll try and integrate more Steamworks features like Achievements or Trading Cards.

Have fun, and let us know your thoughts in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/386750/discussions]Cashtronauts Steam Community discussions[/url]!

-Simon P

notes.title: Private Beta Update: New dialog and co-op improvements
notes.content:
Last night an update was released. A bunch of minor fixes were done, but you'll probably notice the new dialog first. [b]NPCs and enemies now spout short one-liners whenever you attack them, bump into them, or get attacked[/b]. Shop owners will also greet you when you approach. The goal with all this is to add personality and character to the game, and also to subtly explain certain game design elements.

The other big improvement was related to "levelling up". Your ship was already being repaired every time you leveled up, now that will be made clearer with a new level up visual effect. In addition, [b]leveling up in multiplayer will now revive any teammates[/b]. So if you got knocked out you can sit back and cheer on your friend until he/she brings you back!

More updates are coming in the next few weeks, including a big revamp of the existing Risks. Stay tuned for details, and thank you again!

notes.title: Private beta updates and press coverage
notes.content:
Cashtronauts is being patched regularly, and it looks like there'll be no problem hitting the August 12th release date for Early Access. Bloggers and YouTubers have begun taking note of the game, too!

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
Over the past few weeks we've collected a bunch of feedback from playtesters, both from the Steam private beta and playtests that are being done in person here in Montreal. Here's a list of changes that have already gone live:

* Menu flow has been improved to make the Risk system clearer
* Rebalanced Risk bonus percentages
* Rephrased some descriptions and button text to clarify certain points
* Improved the drop rate of weapon and engine upgrades from Tricera-cops and civilians, respectively
* Third-party controllers now supported, not just Xbox 360 gamepads

There are still a lot of changes to come, too:

* Add dialog system for NPCs
* Fix cloud saves
* Minor bugs and balance issues
* Achievements

There'll of course be a lot more updates after that, but that's what we're hoping to have for August 12th when we go live to the public on Early Access.

[h1]Press and YouTubers[/h1]
What with all the bug fixing and patching we haven't had time to reach out to many blogs or YouTubers yet, but stuff has started rolling in nonetheless.

* YouTuber Some Fairlife Milk has a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wg4an3MGG6E]9 minute Let's Play on Youtube[/url]
* YouTuber Absolute Zero played over an hour of Cashtronauts on his [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H6ccPKdtGzI"]YouTube channel[/url]!
* Alexandre at TechnoDabbler wrote up his [url=http://www.technodabbler.com/cashtronauts-get-out-there-and-get-rich/]first impressions of the game[/url]

Thank you all for your help, and wish us luck!

-Simon P
